title: India built a highway with its own wildlife crossing - and the animals are actually using it
sources: Down To Earth, April 2026 - As the Delhi-Dehradun Expressway is opened tomorrow, new study documents 18 wildlife species using key underpass near Haridwar
caption:
India built a highway with its own wildlife crossing. And camera traps show the animals are actually using it.

The Delhi-Dehradun Expressway, opened in April 2026, cuts travel time between the two cities from over 6 hours to about 2.5 hours - and includes a 12 km elevated wildlife corridor through the Rajaji National Park region, widely reported as Asia's longest. A follow-up camera-trap study documented 18 wildlife species - including elephants and golden jackals - already using the underpass to cross safely beneath the highway.

A highway built to move people faster also quietly let a forest keep moving the way it always has.
